description: Daily time series of the official NBU rate for ONE currency over a date range. Pass `valcode` (ISO-4217, e.g. USD) and `start`/`end` as YYYYMMDD. Returns one record per business day: {exchangedate (DD.MM.YYYY), cc, txt (Ukrainian name), enname (English name), rate (UAH per `units`), units, rate_per_unit}. Omit `valcode` to get every currency over the range. Newest first.

valcode.description: ISO-4217 currency code, e.g. "USD". Omit to return all currencies.

name: nbu_currency_history
title: Nbu Currency History
